cleanup.guest: incus delete -f sandbox 2>/dev/null; incus image list -f json | python3 -c 'import json, sys; [print(i["fingerprint"]) for i in json.load(sys.stdin) if i.get("cached")]' | xargs -r -n1 incus image delete; systemctl stop e2e-qs-session.service e2e-qs-session2.service 2>/dev/null; loginctl terminate-user newcomer 2>/dev/null; pkill -KILL -u newcomer 2>/dev/null; systemctl stop user@$(id -u newcomer).service 2>/dev/null; for i in $(seq 80); do pgrep -u newcomer >/dev/null || break; sleep 0.25; done; userdel -r newcomer; rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/90-newcomer; rm -rf /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs /opt/opute-e2e/node /opt/opute-e2e/candidate /tmp/node-compile-cache; systemctl start opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && for i in $(seq 120); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; true

description: The README as written (m33): a fresh sudo user logged in over SSH follows the quickstart with the published @opute/host-agent (0.5.4), allows changes, has the sandbox VM created and removed through the tools an assistant calls, and runs the GitHub release binary checked against SHA256SUMS. Pass: every step the README promises holds on that path.

requirements.requirement: Quickstart 1: start the agent with the published launcher
requirements.scenario: A fresh sudo user with Node 22, logged in over SSH, runs the quickstart's three lines: npm `latest` starts the published 0.5.4 binary in the background on 127.0.0.1:3014 only, with the identity the README's line generates; status reports it running and healthy
requirements.spec: README.md at the commit under test (m33)

requirements.requirement: Quickstart 3 and Safe by default: a read-only first answer
requirements.scenario: The client lists the tools and calls get_host_info; every tool declares its effect hints; a change is refused to the bearer and the refusal names --allow-mutations
requirements.spec: README.md at the commit under test (m33)

requirements.requirement: Quickstart 4: allow changes, then the sandbox VM
requirements.scenario: Restarted with --allow-mutations, the launcher creates opute-workload.slice and the agent serves. After the newcomer logs out and back in and restarts the agent, as step 4 says, the agent holds incus-admin, install_virtualization_stack succeeds, and create_vm makes a running Ubuntu VM called sandbox, which delete_vm removes by the URI create_vm returned
requirements.spec: README.md at the commit under test (m33)

pass.matches: You don't have the needed permissions to talk to the incus daemon .*; newcomer is in incus-admin, but this agent started before that: log in again and restart the agent

requirements.requirement: A refused Incus socket names the remedy
requirements.scenario: The newcomer's first install_virtualization_stack adds the user to incus-admin; the running agent can't use the new group, and its error says to log in again and restart it

requirements.requirement: Install without npm: the GitHub release binary
requirements.scenario: The v0.5.4 x64 binary downloaded from the GitHub release matches SHA256SUMS, reports its version and serves MCP on 127.0.0.1:3014 with the same identity and token
requirements.spec: README.md at the commit under test (m33)

steps.guest: mkdir -p /opt/opute-e2e/node && tar -xJf /opt/opute-e2e/node.tar.xz -C /opt/opute-e2e/node --strip-components=1 && rm /opt/opute-e2e/node.tar.xz && /opt/opute-e2e/node/bin/node --version

useradd -m -s /bin/bash newcomer && printf 'newcomer ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL\n' > /etc/sudoers.d/90-newcomer && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/90-newcomer && visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/90-newcomer >/dev/null && install -d -m 0700 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs && ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -f /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id && install -d -o newcomer -g newcomer -m 0700 /home/newcomer/.ssh && install -o newcomer -g newcomer -m 0600 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id.pub /home/newcomer/.ssh/authorized_keys && id -nG newcomer

systemd-run --unit=e2e-qs-session --collect ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'exec sleep 1700' && for i in $(seq 120); do [ -S /run/user/$(id -u newcomer)/bus ] && [ "$(loginctl show-user newcomer -p State --value)" = active ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; loginctl show-user newcomer -p State --value; test -S /run/user/$(id -u newcomer)/bus && echo bus

ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; sudo -n true && echo sudo; node --version | cut -d. -f1'

ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; openssl rand -hex 32 | tr -d '"'"'\n'"'"' | wc -c'
systemctl stop opute-bootstrap-mcp.service && systemctl is-active opute-bootstrap-mcp.service; true

ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; export OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID="local-$(openssl rand -hex 8)"   # this agent'"'"'s identity
export MCP_AUTH_TOKEN="${SECRET:qs}"                           # the bearer token (harness secret)
npx -y @opute/host-agent start --background
(umask 077; export -p | grep -E '"'"' (OPUTE_REMOTE_AGENT_ID|MCP_AUTH_TOKEN|OPUTE_HOST_AGENT_BINARY)='"'"' > ~/.qs-shell)'

ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; . ~/.qs-shell; npx @opute/host-agent status'
python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py listen 3014
pid=$(ss -ltnpH 'sport = :3014' | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); sha256sum /proc/$pid/exe | cut -c1-64; stat -c %U /proc/$pid; /proc/$pid/exe --version

python3 -c 'import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/opute-e2e/guest"); import mcpwire
tools = mcpwire.mcp(3014, sys.argv[1], "tools/list")["body"]["result"]["tools"]
ann = [t.get("annotations") or {} for t in tools]
print(json.dumps({"tools": len(tools), "withoutReadOnlyHint": sum("readOnlyHint" not in x for x in ann), "writeWithoutDestructiveHint": sum(x.get("readOnlyHint") is False and "destructiveHint" not in x for x in ann)}))' '${SECRET:qs}'

ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; . ~/.qs-shell; npx @opute/host-agent stop
npx -y @opute/host-agent start --background --allow-mutations'

test -f /home/newcomer/.config/systemd/user/opute-workload.slice && echo slice; ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; systemctl --user show -p LoadState --value opute-workload.slice'

ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; . ~/.qs-shell; npx @opute/host-agent status'
id -nG newcomer

systemctl stop e2e-qs-session.service; for i in $(seq 120); do loginctl show-user newcomer >/dev/null 2>&1 || break; sleep 0.25; done; loginctl show-user newcomer -p State --value 2>/dev/null || echo offline

systemd-run --unit=e2e-qs-session2 --collect ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'exec sleep 1500' && for i in $(seq 120); do [ -S /run/user/$(id -u newcomer)/bus ] && break; sleep 0.25; done; test -S /run/user/$(id -u newcomer)/bus && echo bus

ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; . ~/.qs-shell; npx @opute/host-agent stop
npx -y @opute/host-agent start --background --allow-mutations'
gid=$(getent group incus-admin | cut -d: -f3); grep ^Groups: /proc/$(ss -ltnpH 'sport = :3014' | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)/status | tr '\t ' '\n\n' | grep -cx $gid
systemctl is-active incus; incus version >/dev/null && echo incus
incus list sandbox -c ns -f csv; incus list --all-projects -c ns -f csv | grep -c sandbox; true
incus list --all-projects -c n -f csv | grep -c '^sandbox$'; true

ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; . ~/.qs-shell; npx @opute/host-agent stop'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:3014/health; true

ssh -i /opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/id -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/opute-e2e/guest/qs/known_hosts -o LogLevel=ERROR newcomer@127.0.0.1 'export PATH=/opt/opute-e2e/node/bin:$PATH; . ~/.qs-shell; mkdir -p ~/rel && cd ~/rel && curl -fsSLO https://github.com/wunderous/opute-host-agent/releases/download/v0.5.4/host-agent-linux-x64 && curl -fsSLO https://github.com/wunderous/opute-host-agent/releases/download/v0.5.4/SHA256SUMS && sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS && chmod +x host-agent-linux-x64 && ./host-agent-linux-x64 --version && (nohup ./host-agent-linux-x64 > agent.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &) && for i in $(seq 60); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health && break; sleep 0.5; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '"'"'%{http_code}\n'"'"' http://127.0.0.1:3014/health'

pkill -u newcomer -f host-agent-linux-x64; for i in $(seq 40); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:3014/health || break; sleep 0.25; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:3014/health; true
